label: 390x844
js: (async () => { const z = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); game.hold(true); document.body.classList.add('touch'); const out = [];game.showTitle(); game.step(0.1); await z(200); out.push(layoutReport('title'));game.start({ players: 1, who: 'teddy', level: 'easy', go: true }); game.step(0.1); await z(200); out.push(layoutReport('play 1P'));game.start({ players: 2, mode: 'coop', level: 'easy', go: true }); game.step(0.1); await z(200); out.push(layoutReport('play 2P'));game.showResults && (game.world().pl.forEach((p, i) => { p.lives = 0; game.world().riders[i].state = 'out'; }), game.step(4)); await z(200); out.push(layoutReport('results 2P'));game.showTitle(); return JSON.stringify(out.map((o) => [o.label, o.field.join(','), 'tap ' + o.minTap, o.problems.join('; ') || 'ok'])); })()
